name: web-quality-skills
title_zh: 把 Lighthouse 报告变成可执行的网页优化清
tagline_zh: 别再看满屏红黄绿的审计项发呆。这套 skill 把 Core Web Vitals 拆成一步步改法。
tagline_en: Stop staring at Lighthouse scores. This turns Core Web Vitals audits into step-by-step fixes you can actually.
desc_en: Agent Skills for optimizing web quality based on Lighthouse and Core Web Vitals.
why_zh: 不是给建议，是直接读你的 Lighthouse JSON，按影响排序生成改动清单。
why_en: It parses your Lighthouse JSON, ranks fixes by impact, and tells you exactly what to change and how to re-measure.
limit_zh: 只认 Lighthouse 导出的 JSON 报告，且需含 performance 分类。不覆盖图片压缩。
limit_en: Only works with Lighthouse JSON exports containing the performance category. No infra-level fixes (image compression, CDN). Output is a checklist.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。
